$comment: Provenance for every audio file this repository SHIPS. Read docs/decisions/pad-licensing.md
before adding one: the rule is CC0 or an equivalent public-domain dedication, and
attribution-requiring audio is refused rather than credited, because a radio station has
nowhere to put a credit and the obligation would travel to the operator in silence.
An entry is a claim about BYTES rather than about a page. `sha256` is what makes it
checkable by somebody who was not there when it was downloaded, and `uploader` is recorded
because CC0 on a user-upload site is self-asserted -- naming who asserted it does not make
it true, it makes a bad entry findable.
`set` is the directory the file goes in, which is the set an operator's station will end up
with. `name` is what a script writes: [sfx:<name>].
Nothing ships yet. `pads` is empty deliberately rather than pending -- see the decision.
